THE QUESTION

A mortgage approval is only the beginning.

Can a household buy a home while retaining its emergency reserve and the monthly savings it values? This planner makes that trade-off visible alongside lender-style income screening and long-term rent-versus-buy outcomes.

Purchase capital

Down payment, closing costs and a protected reserve.

Income screening

Modeled debt-service ratios and qualifying mortgage payment.

Monthly cash flow

Ownership expenses, household commitments and remaining surplus.

Lifestyle preservation

A chosen savings target, including estimated savings while renting.

HOW TO EXPLORE

One scenario. Several useful perspectives.

  1. Set up: enter price, financing, income, assets, expenses and rental assumptions.
  2. Compare: inspect qualification, liquidity, rent-versus-buy projections and downside scenarios.
  3. Decide: review the binding constraints and savings target in Financial Decision Summary.
  4. Export: download the Excel analysis from Advanced Analytics & Export.
Educational prototype · British Columbia, Canada

Deterministic scenarios are planning illustrations, not lender approval, a forecast or financial advice. Net income is an input assumption. Tax and underwriting rules require independent verification. Inputs and saved comparisons are held within the current application session.

Project overview

Developed from a housing affordability spreadsheet concept into an eight-page decision-support prototype for British Columbia. The planner separates purchase capital, income screening, monthly cash flow and protected savings, then explores how a purchase could change liquidity and long-term net worth.

Model and implementation

Python calculation modules support a Streamlit interface with shared scenario inputs, Plotly charts and OpenPyXL exports. Canadian mortgage interest is converted from a nominal semiannual rate to an effective monthly rate. The affordability scan searches candidate prices in CAD 1,000 increments up to CAD 2.5 million.

Validation and reproducibility

The v2.4.2 GitHub Actions run passed all 70 automated tests on Ubuntu and Windows with Python 3.10 and 3.12. These regression checks cover calculation behavior and selected interface structure; they do not establish lending-policy compliance or forecast accuracy.

My contribution

Developed the planner through iterative financial modeling, interface design and scenario testing. The project combines Python calculation modules, a shared scenario workflow, interactive visualizations, conditional decision pathways, regression tests and publishing documentation.
